tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Verified: every colour var this render injects matches design-tokens.yaml 2.3.0 in BOTH the light :root block and the prefers-color-scheme:dark block (3400 vars across the 23 re-stamped screens, 0 mismatches). Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
no_loading_state: SettingsUiState declares only Content, Empty and Error — there is no loading state, correct for a screen fed by a local preferences stream rather than a network call.
three_affordances: The About section renders three rows with three DIFFERENT affordances: chevron (Licences, in-app), external-link glyph (Privacy, leaves the app), and nothing at all (App version, inert). Asserting the absence on App version is what keeps the other two meaningful — and leaving a banking app mid-session is exactly the shape of a phishing prompt (TC-SET-005/006/007).
single_consents_row: One Consents row pointing at consent-list. If TWO-GENERATIONS resolves toward consent-manager this is the assertion that has to change — it will fail loudly rather than silently render two consent entry points.
